kind: independent explicit SQL proof strategy preregistration

strategy.default: No SQL proof exemption; existing v3 conservative semantics retained.

checks: Default normalization and analysis remain inconclusive/history:null for all seven original inputs.

Explicit normalization/analysis accept only schedule-and-server-clock, acquire-heartbeat-cleanup and body-exception-cleanup as complete/consistent, retaining exact raw observations and proved source facts.

Explicit busy-acquisition/ownership-lost stay inconclusive for zero-row source absence; heartbeat-reconnect stays inconclusive for unknown old outcome; failed arbitrary statement stays inconclusive even with known server abort.
Execution report records exact selected strategy; verifyV3 recalculates with recorded strategy and effective limits.
makeCapsuleV3 and replayCapsuleV3 use the recorded strategy for normalizedText, report and evidence, preserving old default v3 capsule replay.
Removing/changing strategy, model, limits, source fact or normalized evidence while retaining an incompatible result must fail verification and replay even after recomputing local envelope hashes.
Unknown or wrongly typed strategy options must not silently gain the supported strategy.
New explicit source handling does not fabricate reads, condition sources, transaction ACK order or inferred input version facts.
Reduction candidate source closure is revalidated; source-required transactions cannot be removed. No negative guard receives a retroactive source from final state.
The original type/typeCode failure and earlier failed SQL/snapshot audit remain preserved.
limits: This is a planned independent acceptance contract. Semantic coherence of supplied facts is distinct from authenticated database provenance, human installation and full application adoption.
